create.name: Gemma Petherbridge
create.bio:
Gemma Petherbridge, a British crystal healer, Akashic Records reader and teacher, grew up near Stonehenge and Avebury and says she has been psychic since childhood. When she lost both parents in her early twenties, she left a corporate career behind for spiritual study, and across more than twenty years she has built up a wide range of qualifications in crystal healing, energy work and related fields. Conscience Crystals came first, in 2017; she then founded The Crystal Mystery School, an online academy running accredited trainings.

Courses at the school include crystal healing certification, Akashic Records reading at two levels (first personal practice, then professional practitioner training) and cacao ceremony facilitation, delivered through live online classes, recorded lessons and a student community. In London she teaches workshops on intuition, meditation writing and crystal lore for the College of Psychic Studies, and she also teaches on The Shift Network. Octopus publishes her books: Your Crystal Plan; The Crystal Almanac, which follows crystals through the seasons, lunar phases and festivals of the year; and Find Your Light, a guide to lightwork and intuition.

Healing Beyond the Physical: Energy Medicine, Intuition & the Akashic Records

books.title: Your Crystal Plan: 75 crystals to unblock your path and achieve your purpose
books.author: Gemma Petherbridge
books.description: A guide to choosing crystals around personal goals. Readers set physical, emotional and soul aims, then use the chakra system to pick crystals and build their own plan for areas such as love, purpose and connection with the higher self.

books.title: The Crystal Almanac: Harness Your Crystals Through the Year
books.author: Gemma Petherbridge
books.description: A month-by-month crystal companion that follows the seasons, festivals, lunar phases and astrological cycles. Each month pairs crystals with its themes and a goddess of that time of year, with two hands-on activities.

courses.title: Akashic Records Reading Level 2: Professional Practitioner Certification
courses.description: A seven-week online certification for students who already read their own Akashic Records and want to read for others. It combines recorded training, weekly live practice sessions with Gemma, case studies and ethics, and leads to an accredited practitioner certificate.

courses.title: How to Create Powerful Meditations and Visualisations
courses.description: A two-part livestream workshop at the College of Psychic Studies on writing meditations and visualisations for others. It covers structure, language, pacing and sensory cues, and the difference between meditation and visualisation.

courses.title: Intuition in the Workplace
courses.description: A two-part livestream workshop at the College of Psychic Studies on recognising your own intuition and using it in everyday working life. It looks at how intuition speaks to each person and simple ways to stay connected to it under pressure.

free_resources.title: Intuition Made Simple
free_resources.description: A free six-part video mini-series, about 20 minutes a day, on recognising and trusting your intuition. Lessons cover signs and synchronicities, the clair senses and simple exercises to try straight away.
